mechanism: Group each original pair of exposed tip arms as one local triangular lobe. Targets confusing the five visible pointed lobes with the minimum number of full overlapping triangles; the five open V pairs do not draw any hidden base or assert a partition.
primary_unique_math_proof: The source has five convex tips. Every hull of three tips protrudes outside the original star, proved for all ten triples by polygon clipping in three_triangle_proof.json; a contained triangle can therefore include at most two tips, so two triangles cannot cover all five. The same audit gives an explicit cover by three triangles formed from the original supporting lines, verifies each is contained in the star, and verifies the full union equals the original star area. Thus the exact minimum is3; contour coloring does not alter this region.
primary_human_clarity_assessment: Only ten existing contour intervals are recolored into five open V lobes. No lobe base, interior partition, additional triangle, vertex or fill is added. Each colored pair singles out a genuine exposed tip feature and the original star silhouette stays completely readable.
